instruction: Candid medium shot in a ballet studio. On the left, the female instructor in a black bodysuit (R1) stands gesturing with her arm raised. On the right, the young ballet student in a white leotard and tutu (R2) stands with her leg extended on the barre, looking attentively at the instructor. Soft indoor lighting fills the gray-walled room.
